browsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
browsers.answer: Transcription uses the browser's Web Speech API, which works in Chrome, Edge, and Safari. Firefox does not support it, so the tool will not work there.

microphone.question: Why is the microphone not working?
microphone.answer: Your browser needs permission to use the mic — look for the permission prompt or the mic icon in the address bar. Also check that no other app is holding the microphone.

free.question: Is transcription free?
free.answer: Yes, the raw transcription itself is free because it happens entirely in your browser. Only the optional AI cleanup step costs tokens.

cleanup.question: What does the AI cleanup do and what does it cost?
cleanup.answer: It fixes punctuation, capitalization, and obvious mis-hearings in the raw transcript. Cost scales with transcript length at roughly 1 text token per 6 characters.

upload.question: Can I upload an audio file instead of speaking live?
upload.answer: Not currently — the tool transcribes live microphone input only. For recorded audio, play it near your mic as a workaround, though accuracy will be lower.
